description: `accounts usage --detail ACCOUNT` (card 20260930-b-57dbff): detail is grok-only. A configured non-grok seat gets a one-line redirect instead of a table; a configured grok seat with no session home gets the same `no grok sessions found` line `usage` (bare) would reach too; an unconfigured name is a config error, exit 3.

home.config_toml:
[accounts.explorer-seat]
kind = "codex"
config_dir_var = "CODEX_HOME"
config_dir = "{{DIR:codex-home}}"
pool = "codex:test"

[accounts.scout-seat]
kind = "grok"
config_dir_var = "GROK_HOME"
config_dir = "{{DIR:grok-home}}"
pool = "grok:test"

[projects.sandbox]
path = "{{PROJECT:sandbox}}"

expect.stdout: explorer-seat is a "codex" seat — only grok has a per-day/per-project detail source today (card <ID>).
scout-seat: no grok sessions found in the last 7d.

expect.stderr: config error: unknown account "nosuchaccount"; configured accounts: explorer-seat, scout-seat
